description: This source file provides platform-specific upgrade functions and firmware identification logic for the OpenWrt project targeting BCM53XX devices. It includes functions for reading firmware headers, identifying firmware formats, handling NAND and SafeLoader upgrades, and device-specific upgrade procedures.

methods.name: get_magic_long_at
methods.description: Reads a 4-byte magic number from a file at a specified offset.

methods.name: get_le_long_at
methods.description: Reads a 4-byte little-endian long number from a file at a specified offset.

methods.name: platform_flash_type
methods.description: Determines whether the device's root filesystem is on NAND or serial flash.

methods.name: platform_expected_image
methods.description: Returns the expected firmware image name for the current device model.

methods.name: platform_identify
methods.description: Identifies firmware format and extracts metadata based on file header magic numbers.

methods.name: platform_other_check_image
methods.description: Performs validation checks on firmware images based on identified format.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Main function to validate the firmware image before upgrade, considering device model.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_nand_trx
methods.description: Handles the upgrade process for NAND devices with TRX firmware images.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_nand_seamaseal
methods.description: Handles the upgrade process for NAND devices using SeamaSeal firmware packages.

methods.name: platform_img_from_safeloader
methods.description: Extracts image partitions from a SafeLoader firmware package.

methods.name: platform_other_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the appropriate upgrade procedure based on identified firmware format.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade dispatcher that calls specific upgrade routines according to device model.
